comment: Extraction results on Magic's own output that differ from the checked parameters,
seen in the first full sweep (2026-11-21, Magic 8.3.681, open_pdks 026824c7). Both sides
(Magic's GDS and the PCell's GDS) must still give the same netlist; a point that matches
an entry here passes the identity check as a known Magic behaviour, and the report lists it.

known.rule: every second finger extracts as the g5v0d10v5 model with a different length; ceil(nf/2)*m devices keep the right model, w and l, and the total is nf*m
known.note: With nf >= 2, Magic's extraction of Magic's own 16 V drain-extended FET reports floor(nf/2)*m devices as the 10.5 V model.
